howThisRepairWasScoped.claimScoping: THE BOUND IS THE CLAIM, restated with the constraint named precisely (ADV-EIR9-02): the resolved value's 2520 string leaves form a FINITE, CLOSED spelling space, so an absolute zero is establishable in principle by exhaustive sentence-level reading -- but the record shows unaided exhaustive reading is DEMONSTRATED-UNRELIABLE, not impossible: four full-text reviews of v5 read these exact leaves and missed both carriers.
